items.summary: Recommendation: retain CRO and SEO opportunities as deferred backlog; do not create or requeue implementation work this cycle. Existing failures require documented ownership, root cause, deduplication, deterministic validation, rollback, and measurement readiness first. Continue only existing repair-or-close and isolated validation work.

Approve containment-only execution. No new proposal, change request, requeue, deployment, experiment, dependency, telemetry, spend, monetization change, or unsupported financial claim is queue-eligible this cycle. Retain evidence-backed opportunities as deferred backlog. Continue only existing failure repair-or-close, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Preserve private launch gates, parked-site dispositions, and unsent external outreach.

Technical feasibility is not the blocker for the deferred opportunities; queue entry is blocked by unresolved failure ownership, root cause, deduplication, deterministic validation, rollback, and measurement readiness. Continue existing repair-or-close work and do not create duplicate implementation work.

Maintain private launch gates and parked-site dispositions. Continue the existing consolidated rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work only. Keep external outreach unsent and authorize no public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credential or configuration change, dependency addition, deployment, or spend.

Continue existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed and retain revenue attribution, margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift as unknown. Do not infer financial returns from operating metrics or conflicting cost records.
